title: Positive PROGRESS results for zilurgisertib in children aged 6–11 with FOP – Mirum - Medical Update Online
summary:
Mirum Pharmaceuticals, Inc. announced positive results from Cohort 2 of the pivotal PROGRESS study of ATEBRIOZ (zilurgisertib), an oral activin receptor-like kinase 2 (ALK2) inhibitor, in pediatric patients aged 6 to <12 years with fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva (FOP).

At Week 24, zilurgisertib reduced total heterotopic ossification (HO) lesion volume and improved clinician-assessed joint mobility. No zilurgisertib-treated patients developed new HO lesions.

title: FDA approves levacetylleucine for ataxia-telangiectasia | ACNR
summary:
The US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has approved levacetylleucine (Aqneursa, IntraBio) for the treatment of ataxia in adults and children with ataxia-telangiectasia (A-T) weighing at least 15 kg. The decision marks the first FDA-approved treatment specifically indicated for A-T, a rare genetic disorder affecting multiple body systems, including the nervous system, and associated with progressive difficulties with movement and coordination.
